class: A record of a past event (a stored alert, a held rule row) that is worded or stored with figures read at a later moment: the figure and the event no longer belong together, so the text can contradict the record's own numbers.
mechanism: The sentence or the stored field fell back to the latest check's value, threshold or limit instead of the sample that confirmed the event, and a held ladder row stored no rung of its own.

first_seen.where: GC-ICFIX screen walk-through, strategy 149 trade page (test-data copy), then code review of commits 870a3170..871d0baa
first_seen.evidence: Screen: 'Profit before charges -Rs 2,275.00 reached your target of 50%' (a loss that 'reached' a target; the held sentence used the live loss). Review (Sonnet, Tier B): background.py stored limit from the latest check; a Held row for a ladder rule stored threshold None (restore_held then could not end the hold by the band). Opus Tier A confirmed the in-branch regression was fixed in 15967796.

fix: Held target sentence uses the record's own figures and the user's stored target (5eac813a, 13649f51); a stored yes/no alert keeps the confirming sample's value, threshold and limit (871d0baa); a held ladder row keeps its rung (15967796).

detection.note: Guarded for the figures those tests name (held target sentence, yes/no value, limit, held rung). NOT guarded for eight more record fields that still read the latest check: target figures, T-19 approach and cost, approaches, carry, beyond, label/unit, stage, adjustments; and a held T-19 flag still gets the live cheapest approach. Parked as an issue.
